title: Hāngī
description: Hāngī is a dish from New Zealand featuring lamb shoulder, whole chicken, rosemary, banana leaf. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used. Home oven-roasted hāngī-style meal; authentic Māori hāngī uses a pit and heated stones.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 70 minutes.
Layer the prepared meat and vegetables on food-safe banana leaves or inside a covered roasting pan, making a tight packet for steam to circulate.
Seal the meat and vegetables in food-safe leaf parcels or covered oven trays and roast gently until lamb is tender and chicken reaches 74°C; this is not a real earth-oven hāngī.
Rest the cooked meat loosely covered for about 20 minutes before slicing to retain juices.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
